name: Cuisinart Metal Classic 4-Slice Toaster (Functional / Missing Screw)
description: Get crunchy, golden toasts perfectly prepped in seconds with this heavy-duty breakfast classic! This authentic Cuisinart Metal Classic 4-Slice Toaster features premium brushed stainless steel housing with elegant polished chrome accents. Engineered with dual independent control panels, 6-setting browning dials, and specialized custom buttons for Bagel, Defrost, and Reheat options. It effortlessly toasts 4 thick slices of artisan bread or bagels at once. Please note: The unit is fully functional and cooks perfectly fine, but a structural screw on the back casing fell out. It is priced exceptionally low to reflect this cosmetic imperfection. Perfect for anyone looking for a premium, heavy-duty Cuisinart appliance on a deep budget!
contact_note: Cat-friendly home. Fully tested, heats up beautifully, and works perfectly despite the missing screw on the back. Has been fully crumb-cleaned and sanitized. Porch pickup ready!
meta_description: Pre-owned Cuisinart Metal Classic 4-slice stainless steel toaster (Model CPT-180) in fair condition. Missing a back screw but fully functional and working perfectly.
name_zh: 美膳雅 Cuisinart 经典金属4片全不锈钢烤面包机/多士炉 (功能完全正常/后方掉落螺丝低价出)
description_zh: 早餐和简餐爱好者的厨房硬核高配！这款原装美膳雅 Cuisinart 经典金属系列四片装烤面包机（型号 CPT-180），采用高质感拉丝不锈钢机身拼抛光铬合金饰边。带左右两组完全独立的智能控制面板和6档精准焦度旋转调节，支持一键烘烤百叶圈（Bagel）、一键解冻（Defrost）和一键再加热（Reheat），加宽卡槽能轻松塞下厚切吐司。特别说明：机器加热和弹跳功能完全正常。但【机身背面掉落了一颗固定螺丝】，导致外壳结构有微小瑕疵，因此特意超低价转让。家里养猫，发布前已做深度内部清渣与消毒处理。
